narration.full_text: Namaste students! Welcome to an advanced quiz on Control and Coordination. This section will challenge your understanding with some thought-provoking questions. Let's see how well you've grasped the concepts. First question: During exercise, the breathing rate is automatically enhanced. What is the reason behind it? Think about the body's needs during physical activity. The answer is: During exercise, the body demands more energy and oxygen. To fulfill these, the breathing rate is automatically enhanced, and the heart beats faster, sending more oxygenated blood to the muscles. Next, we have a diagram-based question. Draw a neat diagram of the human brain and label the Midbrain, Pituitary gland, Cerebellum, and Cerebrum. Or, alternatively, identify the main thinking part of the brain. Take your time to recall the structure of the brain. The answer for the main thinking part of the brain is the Fore-brain. Now, let's move to hormones. Explain the feedback mechanism to regulate the action of hormones with the help of a suitable example. This is a crucial concept in the endocrine system. Here's the explanation: Hormones should be secreted in precise quantities. The timing and amount are regulated by a feedback mechanism. For example, if blood sugar rises, pancreatic cells produce more insulin. As blood sugar falls, insulin secretion is reduced. Finally, state three common features of the respiratory organs of animals. Consider what makes them efficient for gas exchange. The three common features are: All respiratory organs have a large surface area for enough oxygen. They are thin-walled for easy diffusion of gases. And they have a rich blood supply for transporting respiratory gases. Great job, everyone! I hope this quiz helped solidify your understanding of Control and Coordination.

visual_beats.description: Title: Advanced Quiz: Control and Coordination
Question: During exercise, the breathing rate is automatically enhanced. What is the reason behind it?

Answer: During exercise, the body demands more energy and oxygen. To fulfill these demands, the breathing rate is automatically enhanced, the heart beats faster, thus sending a greater volume of oxygenated blood to the muscles.

Question: Draw a neat diagram of human brain and label on it the following parts: 1. Mid brain 2. Pituitary gland 3. Cerebellum 4. Cerebrum OR (i) Draw a well - labelled diagram of human brain. (ii) Which is the main thinking part of brain?
Answer: (i) Labelled diagram of Human brain (image of brain can be shown here) (ii) Fore-brain.
Question: Explain the feed back mechanism to regulate the action of the hormone s with the help of one suitable example.

Answer: Hormones should be secreted in precise quantities. The timing and amount of hormone released are regulated by feedback mechanism. For example, if the sugar level in blood rises, they are detected by the cells of the pancreas which respond by producing more insulin. As the blood sugar level, falls, insulin secretion is reduced.
Question: State three common features of respiratory organs of animals.

Answer: (i) All respiratory organs have large surface area to get enough oxygen. (ii) They are thin-walled for easy diffusion of gases and substances. (iii) They have rich supply of blood for transporting respiratory gases.
